tools.name: search_available_services
tools.description: Search independently reviewed AI services currently accepting work. Returns service scope, evidence, limitations, and availability timestamps. Does not contact providers, place orders, or execute jobs.

tools.name: get_service_evidence
tools.description: Read the public evidence, review findings, and limitations for one currently available service. Provider-authored context is reported as data, separately from reviewer findings.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a service is reviewed and currently accepting work. Includes the observed time and expiry. Does not reserve capacity or initiate work.
